deploy.//: Auto-apply pending Prisma migrations BEFORE booting the API. 2026-05-04 — operator hit a string of 'tables don't exist on the DB yet' errors after every feature that added a migration (streaming integrations, BYOK AI, AI quota) because the prior startCommand was `node apps/api/dist/main.js` with no migrate step. `prisma migrate deploy` is idempotent (skips already-applied migrations) so running it on every boot is safe. If a migration is malformed the boot fails fast and the Railway restart policy below retries 10× — better than silently running with a stale schema.
